title: CPU consumed within a two-core entitlement
method: Synthetic 60-second window with a two-core quota: budget = 2 × 60 = 120 CPU-seconds; measured-example usage = 108 CPU-seconds. The chart compares equal-window aggregate quantities, not latency or instantaneous headroom. Three hundred completed jobs give 0.36 CPU-seconds per job.
alt: CPU consumed within a two-core entitlement. Illustrative values: CPU budget 120 CPU-seconds, CPU consumed 108 CPU-seconds.
